name: Rite of Consumption
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Rite of Consumption deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to target player or planeswalker. You gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.
blocked_sentences: Rite of Consumption deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to target player or planeswalker. You gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.

needs.what: an `as` on a spell's `additional_cost.sacrifice` that snapshots the sacrificed creature (608.2h last-known information, as the activated-ability cost does via `costs.pay`'s `bindings`) into the stack item's bindings, so `spell_effects` can read `{"power_of": {"binding": <as>}}` on resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cost.sacrifice.as` loads only on an activated ability's cost (`loader.mana` refuses it elsewhere: 'only an activated ability's effects can read what its cost sacrificed'), so an additional cost to cast pays the sacrifice and binds nothing. The damage-dealt-this-way half is expressible: `damage`'s `as` read by `gain_life`
